findings.text: the lander hands delivery_hold_reason the manifest's delivered token, which _delivered_revision returns verbatim at 7-40 hex characters, while a resume-taken hold records the full worktree head; covers_delivery compares them by exact equality, so a run whose manifest spells its commit abbreviated (as this run's own manifest does with c536fe6d9b) has its hold silently stop covering and is landed anyway. Demonstrated read-only at the reviewed head: covers_delivery(full, full[:10]) is False while recovery.same_revision(full, full[:10]) is True. Pass head, as recovery_review_acceptance.py:507 already does, or compare with recovery.same_revision.

covers_delivery re-implements the revision-equivalence capability already owned by reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:105 (same_revision) with a stricter exact-equality rule rather than extending it, which is what lets the lander and the hold disagree on spelling.

the only case that passes head= exercises hold_delivery directly, so removing head=head from prepare_resume at reckon/crew/resume.py:281 leaves the new delivery-scoped behaviour unguarded and every case still green.

moving the hold check below the same_revision guard means a held run that has not delivered no longer reaches skipped with status held, so a coordinator's hold on an undelivered run is invisible in the pass's report.
